items.t: Roblox Rises 4% on BofA Target Hike Betting on 2027 Reacceleration as GTA VI Launches
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRoblox jumped 4% today after BofA raised its price target to $48 from $45 and kept a Neutral rating, as Take-Two Interactive released Grand Theft Auto VI. BofA sees growth picking up in 2027, as analysts already expect, but still warns of a fourth-quarter miss.

items.t: B of A Securities Maintains Neutral on Roblox, Raises Price Target to $48
items.sum: B of A Securities analyst Omar Dessouky maintains Roblox (NYSE:RBLX) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $45 to $48.

items.t: Roblox (RBLX) Faces Near Term Bookings And Engagement Risks
items.sum: Jefferies flagged near term bookings and engagement risks for Roblox (NYSE:RBLX) in a fresh report released this week. The firm cited competitive pressure from major upcoming gaming releases including GTA VI as a potential drag on user time and spending.
